conceptual_delta: Connect existing capabilities and open research obligations to current official sources, candidate fit, adoption-evidence class and bounded qualification work; HSWM target, FCL laws, claim ceilings and negative evidence remain unchanged.
priority_policy: P0 integrate the existing instrument into one decisive fresh-task study and bridge one executed witness to existing formal contracts. P1 is conditional, narrowly scoped qualification. P2 is a recorded trigger, not a required implementation backlog. None of these tooling qualifications are new gates to conducting authorized research.
scientific_boundary: Tool adoption, graph size, test counts, conformance and observability do not establish HSWM efficacy. G0/G1/second-party protocol mechanics belong to a replaceable route; independent outcomes, strong controls, exact intervention, lineage and claim ceilings remain required under the adaptive strategy.
artifact_selection_policy: This scan does not install or select executable artefacts. Before an actual addition, select a concrete contract, verify official publisher/SDK or label an independent implementation, pin exact source/version and artefact digest/integrity plus licence and lockfile, and run the relevant official suite or bounded smoke. No native canonical-write or causal-credit authority may be derived from a connector, skill or report.
source_boundary: External source records are dated observations and paraphrases, not content-hashed archives of webpage bytes. Current-version observations from mutable official pages are not immutable package pins. Repository evidence is separately fixed to the stated Git cut, excluding concurrent uncommitted work.
